chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from his brother al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah, who said:

I asked him about a man who becomes junub, then performs ghusl before urinating, and then finds moisture after he has performed ghusl. He said: “He repeats the ghusl. But if he had urinated before performing ghusl, then he does not repeat his ghusl; rather, he performs wudu and cleanses himself.”

key_terms.يَسْتَنْجِي: cleanses the private part after discharge
key_terms.يُجْنِبُ: becomes in a state of janabah

ai.seo_question: If someone finds moisture after ghusl al-janabah, must he repeat the ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding ghusl after janabah when moisture is found afterward. It distinguishes between one who urinated before ghusl and one who did not, affecting whether ghusl must be repeated or only wudu and istinja' are required.
